texts.label: BnF fr. 3985 no. 7 (f. 20), Dr Mauclerc to Creil, 1593
texts.summary: A papal-side letter of Dr Mauclerc to Creil, 1593, one of three Mauclerc letters (fr. 3983 f. 268, fr. 3984 f. 33, fr. 3985 f. 20) that carry contemporary interlinear decipherments; the royal office's register fr. 3983 f. 140r summarises them in clear (Brice Dudout, 19 Oct 2026).
texts.note: No text and no link in the repository: the interlinear decipherment is on the Gallica images (btv1b90606498, views 6-13), never transcribed (reading audit, 22 Oct 2026); fix: fetch them through the Gallica IIIF (openapi.bnf.fr) and transcribe the interlinear text.
